target_customer: Consumers and professionals who want a personal assistant they can text, free to use with merchant fees planned
problem: Managing contacts, inboxes, calendars and tasks across many apps is tedious. Pally is a text-message AI assistant that connects to them and handles research, reminders and bookings.
business_model: Free to users, with a planned fee from merchants when users buy through the assistant
product_category: Consumer AI personal assistant over text messaging

founders.name: Haz Hubble
founders.background_notes: YC page describes him as a designer, salesman, engineer and accountant.

founders.name: Wyatt Lansford
prior_employers: Shield AI (company acquired by it, per YC page)
previous_startups: Robotics and autonomy startup acquired by Shield AI (name not given)
founders.background_notes: ML engineer in robotics and autonomy; won the DARPA AlphaDogfight Trials and built autonomous planes and robots, per YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Standard LLM agent engineering with hard parts in integrations (iMessage, WhatsApp, email, calendar), contact aggregation and reliability of actions.

defensibility.rationale: Accumulated memory of a user's contacts and plans gives mild lock-in, but the interface and models are copyable and platform access to messaging is controlled by others.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not documented for Pally. Search coverage shows a text-based agent, Poke, launched in March 2026 and won Apple approval for Messages in June 2026, showing platform gatekeeping and rivals.

market_need_then: Demand for agents that act on email, calendar and messages was rising in 2025, but no usage or revenue figures for Pally were found. The seed press says funds go to growth and marketing.

branding.domain_note: Owns the exact pally.com domain per the company site; acquisition history not found.

identity.logo: Seven stones arranged in a circle, intentionally primitive as if scratched on a cave wall (pally.com/brand)
identity.visual_style: Primitive, minimal mark representing order from chaos and communal gathering
identity.voice_and_tone: Simple, warm and direct; short statements such as We believe in simple things

branding.brand_signature: Seven stones in a circle emblem

brand_strength.rationale: A friendly short name plus a considered brand page with a story, but no evidence of community, memes or merch yet.

outcome_analysis: Pally is an active Summer 2025 company that raised a reported 5.2 million dollar seed in August 2026 at a reported 30 million dollar valuation, led by Cyber Fund and Y Combinator. The raise points to early traction with a two person team, but no usage metrics are public, and the main risks are platform control of messaging and large incumbents.
notes: The seed amount, date and valuation appear in two outlets (The SaaS News and Runtime Wire); lead investors come from The SaaS News and Odaily only. A 1.1 million dollar pre-seed in 2025 appears only in a single deal-aggregator snippet (traded.co) and is not recorded as a round. Competitor search found only 2026 entrants, after the batch, so the list is empty. Founder prior employers and education come only from the YC page.
